profile_text.body:
Andreessen Horowitz, also known as a16z, is a venture capital firm based in Menlo Park, California, in the United States. It was founded in 2009 and operates for profit. On its website the firm describes itself as a Silicon Valley venture capital firm that invests in founders, innovators, and entrepreneurs building the future through technology, and it uses the phrase "Software Is Eating the World."

The site material does not describe any AI products of its own, and no products are tracked for the firm. No lawsuits involving the company are listed, and no MCP servers are associated with it. The only jurisdiction recorded in connection with the firm is California.
